verdict.rationale: Graphite's docs describe its AI reviewer as a "codebase-aware AI code review agent" that automatically reviews every PR. Graphite Chat separately claims to find related files, understand dependencies and pull context from other PRs. Custom rules let teams encode conventions explicitly, but the evidence never shows that the automatic review comments themselves reason about call sites or related modules beyond the diff. missing for 10: explicit documentation of how review comments use repository-wide context (call sites, cross-module impact, inferred conventions), and independent or hands-on corroboration that comments go beyond the changed hunks.
